comments.text:
Implement VolumeFader and PanKnob Vizia views for the mixer channel strips.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.6 (Vizia editor)

VOLUMEFADER: Tall vertical fader (588px track) with ruler marks
- Properties: value (0-127), on_change callback, default (100)
- Visual: narrow groove, wide cap/thumb, right-side ruler with marks at 127/100/80/60/40/20/0, '0dB' label at 100
- Interaction: click-anywhere-on-track to set, drag cap, double-click to reset to default, arrow keys

PANKNOB: Small circular knob for stereo position
- Properties: value (0-127, 64=center), on_change callback
- Visual: circular body with indicator line, display format: L64..C..R63
- Interaction: vertical drag, double-click resets to 64

REFERENCE:
- web/src/VolumeFader.tsx + .module.css (track geometry, ruler mark positions)
- web/src/PanKnob.tsx + .module.css (knob rendering, pan format function)

Place in crates/integral-vst/src/views/.

title: VST/Vizia: implement VolumeFader and PanKnob for mixer strips
